gloss: garnish; accompaniment; side (on the same plate)

definitions.gloss: garnish; accompaniment; side (on the same plate)
definitions.explanation: vegetables or other food served on the same plate as a main dish to complement it, such as potatoes with a steak or shredded radish with sashimi

examples.japanese: ⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The vegetable side dish was also delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦メイン→メイン：11164_mein⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いてくる→付いてくる：29670_tsuitekuru⟧。
examples.english: The main dish comes with a side.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (the accompaniment for ~)
- {付|つ}け{合|あ}わせが⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to come with a side)
- {付|つ}け{合|あ}わせを{添|そ}える (to add a garnish)

TYPES:
- ステーキ/ハンバーグ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (fries, corn, carrots, green beans)
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (shredded ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ and {紫蘇|しそ} leaves, called つま)
- とんかつの{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (shredded cabbage)

WATCH OUT:
{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ sits on the main dish's plate. A separate side dish in a Japanese meal is ⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧, and dishes eaten with rice in general are おかず.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{添|そ}え→添う：13344_sou⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (garnish, accompaniment)
- ⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧ (condiment, garnish for flavor)
